summary: Current OpenCode Console documentation lists Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time, in exchange for permission to use your prompts and completions to train future Meta models. However, repeated current reads of both the inference and legacy Zen catalogs omit the exact muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free ID; published pricing does not establish current selector or API availability. Standard Muse Spark 1.3 remains paid. The docs assign the free variant to https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/responses; the documented no-Authorization exception for free chat models does not verify an account-free Responses path. General Console setup says to add billing details and credits, and a model-specific payment waiver remains unverified. Keep the listing unresolved until a legitimate user confirms the exact selector/API path and funding requirements. No inference request was sent. The existing Zen screenshot is historical evidence, not a current claim-flow test; no campaign end date is established.
claim_steps: Open https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/models/. It still publishes free Contributor pricing, but repeated live inference and Zen catalogs omit muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free; current availability needs confirmation.
Review current Console setup and billing. General instructions say to add billing details and credits; a model-specific payment waiver remains unverified.
If using Console, sign in and copy the API key. In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider and paste the key locally.

Check whether exact opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free is selectable before relying on the promotion. The docs assign it to https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/responses, but live catalog presence and successful use are unresolved.
The no-Authorization exception is documented for free chat models, not a verified account-free route for this Responses model. Do not infer a Console funding waiver; no inference request was tested.
Meta may use your prompts and completions to train future models. The published offer is limited-time with no exact end date; avoid sensitive inputs and verify current pricing before use.
